_readme: House variations for the base's growing city (one building appears per player growth stage). These are the Fab house models, optimized from ~90MB raw exports to <1.2MB each (mesh simplify error 1%, 512px WebP textures, quantized attributes) via @gltf-transform/cli. To add more: drop a .glb/.gltf/.fbx here and append its path. Only list files that actually exist. Source folders 08 and 11 were FBX-only and are not included.
